tagline: Turn confusing notices into clear action checklists
privacyNotice: Your notice stays in this session. Nothing is saved.

hero.headline: Know what the notice really asks you to do.
hero.subhead: Plain-language, evidence-backed action checklist in English and Hindi. Only states what the notice says.

errors.modelFailure: Something went wrong reading this notice. Try again.
errors.network: No connection. Check your internet and try again.
